import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class BubbleStrike {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
        int total = Integer.parseInt(tokenizer.nextToken());
        double probability = Double.parseDouble(tokenizer.nextToken());
        int position = total;
        for (int step = total; step >= 1; step /= 2) {
            while (canReduce(position, total - position, probability)) {
                position -= step;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(position);
    }

    public static boolean canReduce(int good, int bad, double targetProb) {
        double g = good;
        double b = bad;
        double numerator = (0.25 * b * (b - 1) + (g * (g - 1) * (g - 2) / 6.0) + b * 0.5 * g * (g - 1));
        double denominator = ((g + b) * (g + b - 1) * (g + b - 2) / 6.0);
        double result = numerator / denominator;
        return result >= targetProb;
    }
}
